title: Selective Wagering EV Filter + Fractional Kelly 0.3x — From MDPI 2026
source_paper: Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning for NBA Forecasting in Digital Betting Markets, MDPI Information 17(1):56, January 2026
summary: The MDPI 2026 paper (Brier 0.089 via fused model) identifies two techniques that improve economic ROI without changing Brier score: (1) selective wagering with EV > 1.10 threshold and (2) fractional Kelly staking at 0.3x. Both act as a calibration filter — by skipping low-confidence predictions, the effective calibration of placed bets improves dramatically.

key_findings.insight: Fusing market odds directly into the feature vector drops Brier from 0.20 to 0.089. We already include market features (include_market=True in NBAFeatureEngine) but may not be fusing them optimally.
key_findings.calibration_finding: Calibration-selected pipelines consistently achieve higher ROI under both fixed-stake and fractional-Kelly sizing, showing probability reliability affects economic outcomes more than accuracy.
key_findings.ev_filter: EV > 1.10 threshold: place bet only when model_prob × market_odds > 1.10. This filters out marginal bets and improves average calibration of the placed-bet subset.
key_findings.kelly_fraction: Fractional Kelly at 0.3x dampens overconfident prediction impact. Full Kelly is theoretically optimal but practically ruinous with miscalibrated probabilities.
key_findings.era_normalization: Within-season z-normalization + per-100-possessions standardization prevents league evolution from creating lookahead bias (3-point volume doubled 2010-2024).

step_1_ev_filter.change: Add EV threshold filter: only place bet if (model_prob * implied_odds) >= 1.10. Currently no EV filter is applied.
step_1_ev_filter.code_sketch: ev = model_prob * (1 / market_implied_prob); if ev < 1.10: skip_bet()

step_2_fractional_kelly.change: Reduce Kelly fraction from 0.5x (current) to 0.3x. Paper shows 0.3x optimal with miscalibrated models.

step_3_era_normalization.change: Add per-season z-normalization to rolling efficiency features (offensive/defensive rating, eFG%, TS%). Prevents 2020-bubble anomaly and 3PT era drift from creating bias.

step_4_market_fusion_check.change: Verify market features are properly fused: closing line, market movement (open-to-close), sharp money indicator (line move against public), and implied-prob-gap (our prob - market prob). The gap feature is the most valuable.
step_4_market_fusion_check.expected_impact: If market-implied prob is already in features, the gap (our_model - market_implied) is the primary alpha signal.

effort_estimate: LOW — steps 1-2 are 10-line changes in bankroll_manager.py. Step 3 is already researched. Step 4 requires audit of engine.py market features.
blocking: None — no new data sources required.
cross_project_applicability: Apply steps 1-2 to nomos-political-alpha/ops/bankroll_manager.py identically. Kelly fraction and EV filter are model-agnostic.
